producedBy: SRC1, measurement lane. No packet built, no family claimed, no manifest edited.
question: For each family whose declared source identity did not resolve in the custody record, is the declared source in custody or not, measured by content rather than by identifier?
method: A SHA-256 index was built over every file under all five mounted custody roots (22011 files, 18013 unique digests).

A content index was built over every unique PDF among them (1947 PDFs): embedded title, page count, AcroForm/XFA field counts and first-page text, so an instrument can be recognised when its digest has moved.

Every declared sourceHashes[].sha256 in MASTER_QUEUE.json for the named families was looked up in that digest index. This bypasses the tier-ordering defect entirely: no custody row is consulted before the digest, so a family that has a custody row cannot mask a held document.

Unresolved digests were then checked against the committed corpus index (data/rcap-all50/local-source-corpus-index.json, 984 entries) and against the 2026-09-04 acquisition receipts, to separate a missing document from an unmounted custody and from an acquisition that was never materialized.
Nothing was fetched. Every digest, path and page count in this file was produced by a tool run in this container.

custodiesNamedByTheIndexButNotMountedHer.note: The committed index names this custody. It has no mount point in this environment. Eleven of its fourteen entries cannot be opened here; three happen to be duplicated into other mounted trees.

masterQueueSelfContradiction.question: How many MASTER_QUEUE.json rows read sourceStatus SOURCE_BOUND_BY_HELD_BYTES with sourceBound true while carrying a nested sourceReadiness.custodyClass that denies it?
masterQueueSelfContradiction.shape: sourceStatus=SOURCE_BOUND_BY_HELD_BYTES AND sourceBound=true AND sourceReadiness.custodyClass IN (SOURCE_GENUINELY_MISSING, SOURCE_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED)
masterQueueSelfContradiction.whyItMatters: A lane dispatched from the top-level fields of one of these rows is told the source is bound and ready. The nested custodyClass says the opposite. Thirty of these rows are the families measured here; the rest span every queue state including COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN.
masterQueueSelfContradiction.notEditedHere: MASTER_QUEUE.json is generated centrally and was not modified by this lane.

howMuchOfTheBucketIsARecordsDefectRather.question: Of the 30 families the custody record read as SOURCE_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED or SOURCE_GENUINELY_MISSING, how many were wrong about custody?
howMuchOfTheBucketIsARecordsDefectRather.mechanism: The resolution gate returns at tier custody_reconciliation whenever a family has a custody row at all, and never reaches the digest fallback. A family with a custody row therefore reports that it names no resolved document source even when the bytes are sitting in a mounted tree under a different filename. This sweep resolves by digest first and consults no custody row, so it is not subject to that ordering.

recoverableWithoutAcquiringAnything.note: These need no acquisition. The bytes are either already openable, or already recorded as fetched, or sitting in a custody nobody mounted.

theNineFilesMissingFromTheRecoveryPool.finding: The mounted Nationwide_Recovery_Pool_2026-09-02 tree carries 371 of the 380 entries the committed index attributes to it. The nine absent entries are exactly the source-acquisition-2026-09-04 subtree, and that subtree does not exist anywhere under the mounted pool. Seven of the nine have acquisition receipts recording those exact digests fetched on 2026-09-04.
theNineFilesMissingFromTheRecoveryPool.alsoChecked: The chunked corpus recovery pool at private/corpus-recovery-parts (POOL_INDEX.json, 876 hash-addressed files) contains none of the nine digests, so they cannot be reconstructed from it either.

whatThisFileDoesNotEstablish: It is not a state change, not a source determination and not a rebind. No family state, count, claim or treatment is altered by it.

RESOLVED_BY_CONTENT means the declared bytes are openable in this container. It does not mean the instrument is the legally correct one for the route, and it does not mean the packet is buildable: format and coverage blockers are recorded separately per family.

Where a same-titled instrument is held at a digest other than the declared one, this file records it as a candidate and refuses it as a match. Rebinding a family to different bytes is an owner decision.
